name: landio
summary: Near-black AI automation agency page with a dim smoky video hero, Inter headlines finished by an italic Instrument Serif phrase, and glossy dark cards holding small animated UI vignettes.

fonts.pairing: Inter 500 headlines with a closing italic Instrument Serif phrase in every H1 and H2; Inter body at 14-16 in 70% ink

signature: each heading ends in an italic serif phrase set lighter than the grotesk clause before it
glowing app-icon tile above the hero headline with a soft blue under-glow
services bento where each card holds a tiny live UI scene: stacked task chips, orbiting app icons around a sparkle node, a code editor, a search panel
two-column us-versus-others comparison with check and cross rows on frosted dark panels
imagery: no photography in the main flow except testimonial and team portraits; a muted greyscale smoke video with particles in the hero; monochrome glyph icons in small rounded dark tiles
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 40px side padding, 100px section padding, 40px header-to-content gap, 2 and 3 column card grids with 16-24px gaps, 10-16px card radii
